basic.name: 普通攻击：不许动！
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
[突击模式]
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
交替使用体术、手枪和以太鹿弹，向前方进行至多五段的攻击，造成物理伤害和以太伤害；
第四、第五段攻击命中敌人时，获得1枚[强化霰弹]，同一招式中最多获得1枚；
招式发动期间，拖曳摇杆并点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以发动[冲刺攻击：火力奇袭]，向对应方向调整身位；
[突击模式]下，长按 【普通攻击键】 时，将会切换攻击方式，进入[压制模式]。
basic.descriptionEn:
[Assault Mode]
Press [Basic Attack] to activate.
Unleash a flurry of martial arts, bullets, and Ether Buckshots in a series of up to 5 attacks, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
When the 4th or 5th hit strikes an enemy, obtain 1 Enhanced Shotshell per hit. A max of 1 can be obtained per activation of this Basic Attack.
While using this skill, drag the joystick and press [Basic Attack] to activate Dash Attack: Firepower Offensive and readjust to face the selected direction.
While under Assault Mode, hold [Basic Attack] to switch to Suppressive Mode.

special.name: 特殊技：鹿弹射击
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
使用以太鹿弹进行射击，造成以太伤害，连续点按 【特殊技键】 ，可以重复射击三次；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Shoots Ether Buckshots that deal Ether DMG. This can be repeated 3 times by repeatedly pressing [Special Attack].
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：全弹连射
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用以太鹿弹进行连续射击，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得3枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Shoots a series of Ether Buckshots, that explode and deal massive Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：火力震爆
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate.
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
使用以太鹿弹对前方敌人发动射击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得1枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate.
Shoots enemies in front with an Ether Buckshot, dealing Ether DMG.
Gain 1 Enhanced Shotshell on skill use.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：歼灭模式
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
使用完全变形武器进行饱和攻击，发射直线激光和追踪导弹，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得3枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Uses Modified Master Firearm to execute a saturated attack, firing lasers and seeking missiles to deal massive Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:

facts.text: 朱鸢在[压制模式]下，消耗[强化霰弹]进行攻击时，招式造成的伤害提升40%，攻击处于失衡状态下的敌人时，该增益效果额外提升40%；进入战场时，朱鸢立刻获得6枚[强化霰弹]。
facts.textEn: When Zhu Yuan is under Suppressive Mode, using Enhanced Shotshells increases her DMG by 40%. When attacking Stunned enemies, this DMG buff is increased by an additional 40%. When Zhu Yuan enters the battlefield, she immediately gains 6 Enhanced Shotshells.

cinema.name: 快速装填
cinema.description: 朱鸢发动[连携技]/[终结技]时，将获得[快速装填]效果；当朱鸢拥有[快速装填]效果时，耗尽所有[强化霰弹]后，将消耗[快速装填]效果，立刻获得6/9枚[强化霰弹]。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Zhu Yuan activates Chain Attacks/Ultimates, gain the Quick Reload effect. When Zhu Yuan has the Quick Reload effect and uses up all Enhanced Shotshells, the Quick Reload effect will be consumed to instantly gain 6/9 Enhanced Shotshells.

cinema.name: 以太余烬
cinema.description: [压制模式]下，朱鸢的抗打断等级提升，受到伤害降低10%；消耗[强化霰弹]攻击命中敌人时，[普通攻击：请勿抵抗]与[冲刺攻击：火力压制]造成的以太伤害提升10%，最多叠加5层，持续5秒，每次开火最多获得一层效果，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: In Suppressive Mode, Zhu Yuan's Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG taken reduced by 10%. When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, deal 10% more Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower Ether DMG, stacking up to 5 times and lasting for 5s. Each shot adds one stack of this effect, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

cinema.name: 治安官特训
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 以太侵彻
cinema.description: 朱鸢消耗[强化霰弹]攻击命中敌人时，[普通攻击：请勿抵抗]与[冲刺攻击：火力压制]无视目标25%以太伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, her Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower ignore 25% of the target's Ether RES.

cinema.name: 特勤经验
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 扩容能源包-叁型
cinema.description: 朱鸢累计消耗12枚[强化霰弹]时，将获得[以太余温]效果，并使下次发动的[强化特殊技]能量消耗降低30点；发动[强化特殊技]时，将消耗[以太余温]效果，额外发射总计4枚以太鹿弹，每枚额外发射的以太鹿弹将造成朱鸢220%攻击力的伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Zhu Yuan consumes a total of 12 Enhanced Shotshells, she receives the Ether Afterglow effect, and the Energy cost of the next EX Special Attack is reduced by 30. Launching an EX Special Attack will consume Ether Afterglow and shoot an additional 4-bullet Ether Buckshot. Each extra bullet deals DMG equal to 220% of Zhu Yuan's ATK.

notes: 曾为限定UP，现为定制调频候选；本功能按原生限定口径计1，不称为开服常驻，也不推断账号获取时是否为UP。

124100002.nameEn: Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist
124100002.description:
[压制模式]
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
使用霰弹枪向前方进行至多三段的穿透射击，造成物理伤害；开火时若拥有[强化霰弹]，则会消耗1枚[强化霰弹]，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动期间，拖曳摇杆可以发动[冲刺攻击：火力压制]，向对应方向调整身位；
[压制模式]下，松开 【普通攻击键】 时，将会切换攻击方式，回到[突击模式]。
124100002.descriptionEn:
[Suppressive Mode]
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleash up to 3 Shotshell piercing attacks, dealing Physical DMG. If Zhu Yuan has Enhanced Shotshells upon firing, 1 Enhanced Shotshell will be consumed, dealing massive Ether DMG.
While using this skill, drag the joystick to activate her Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower and readjust to face the selected direction.
While in Suppressive Mode, release [Basic Attack] to return to Assault Mode.

124100004.name: 强化特殊技：全弹连射
124100004.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用以太鹿弹进行连续射击，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得3枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
124100004.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Shoots a series of Ether Buckshots, that explode and deal massive Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

124100009.name: 连携技：歼灭模式
124100009.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
使用完全变形武器进行饱和攻击，发射直线激光和追踪导弹，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得3枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
124100009.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Uses Modified Master Firearm to execute a saturated attack, firing lasers and seeking missiles to deal massive Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

124100010.name: 终结技：歼灭模式MAX
124100010.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
使用完全变形武器进行饱和攻击，发射直线激光和追踪导弹，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得3枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
124100010.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Uses Modified Master Firearm to execute a saturated attack, firing lasers and seeking missiles to deal massive Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

124100012.name: 快速支援：掩护射击
124100012.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
使用以太鹿弹对前方敌人发动射击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动时，获得1枚[强化霰弹]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
124100012.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Shoots enemies in front with an Ether Buckshot, dealing Ether DMG.
Gain 1 Enhanced Shotshell on skill use.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
